_README: Usage notes for published assets, keyed by repository path. The build scans assets/ for the inventory and merges these notes in. A file with no note still publishes, it just carries no guidance. The build never overwrites this file. Add a note whenever an asset has a rule attached to it, and always when an asset is a counter-example.

assets/signatures/nathaniel-zimmer.svg.name: Signature, Nathaniel Zimmer
assets/signatures/nathaniel-zimmer.svg.note: Nathan Zimmer's default signature. Cleanest of the three full forms and the most legible, so it is the one to use on documents and letterhead unless there is a reason to reach for another. Vector master: scale it, never redraw it.

assets/signatures/nathaniel-zimmer.png.name: Signature, Nathaniel Zimmer, raster
assets/signatures/nathaniel-zimmer.png.note: Transparent PNG of the default signature, 1200px tall. For the places that cannot take SVG: Google Docs, PDF and e-sign fields, email signatures. Prefer the SVG everywhere else.

assets/signatures/nathaniel-zimmer-displ.name: Signature, Nathaniel Zimmer, display
assets/signatures/nathaniel-zimmer-displ.note: Faster and more slanted, with a long lead-in and a trailing flick. Holds its energy at large sizes. Not for small settings, where the flick reads as noise.

assets/signatures/nathaniel-zimmer-displ.name: Signature, Nathaniel Zimmer, display, raster
assets/signatures/nathaniel-zimmer-displ.note: Transparent PNG of the display signature, 1200px tall. Same rule: SVG unless the destination refuses it.

assets/signatures/nathaniel-zimmer-compa.name: Signature, Nathaniel Zimmer, compact
assets/signatures/nathaniel-zimmer-compa.note: Tightest of the three, with heavier looping on the Z. The one that survives being scaled down.

assets/signatures/nathaniel-zimmer-compa.name: Signature, Nathaniel Zimmer, compact, raster
assets/signatures/nathaniel-zimmer-compa.note: Transparent PNG of the compact signature, 1200px tall. Same rule: SVG unless the destination refuses it.

assets/signatures/nathan-zimmer.svg.name: Signature, Nathan Zimmer, short form
assets/signatures/nathan-zimmer.svg.note: The short form. Widest stroke relative to its width, so it stays readable in tight spaces like an email footer. Use the full name on anything entered into the record.

assets/signatures/nathan-zimmer.png.name: Signature, Nathan Zimmer, short form, raster
assets/signatures/nathan-zimmer.png.note: Transparent PNG of the short form, 1200px tall. Same rule: SVG unless the destination refuses it.

assets/signatures/joel-zimmer.svg.name: Signature, Joel Zimmer
assets/signatures/joel-zimmer.svg.note: Joel Zimmer's default signature. The widest of the three, with a trailing stroke carrying almost a third of the total width, so it fills a signature line rather than sitting short of it. Place this one on documents and letterhead unless there is a reason to reach for another. Vector master: scale it, never redraw it.

assets/signatures/joel-zimmer.png.name: Signature, Joel Zimmer, raster
assets/signatures/joel-zimmer.png.note: Transparent PNG of Joel Zimmer's default signature, 1200px tall. For the places that cannot take SVG: Google Docs, PDF and e-sign fields, email signatures. Prefer the SVG everywhere else.

assets/signatures/joel-zimmer-display.sv.name: Signature, Joel Zimmer, display
assets/signatures/joel-zimmer-display.sv.note: The fastest of the three, with a high sweeping stroke arcing back over the last name. It carries the most character at large sizes. Not for small settings, where the arc closes up and reads as a smudge.

assets/signatures/joel-zimmer-display.pn.name: Signature, Joel Zimmer, display, raster
assets/signatures/joel-zimmer-display.pn.note: Transparent PNG of Joel Zimmer's display signature, 1200px tall. Same rule: SVG unless the destination refuses it.

assets/signatures/joel-zimmer-compact.sv.name: Signature, Joel Zimmer, compact
assets/signatures/joel-zimmer-compact.sv.note: Tightest of the three, and the most upright and open: largest J bowl, clearest gap between the names. The one that survives being scaled down.

assets/signatures/joel-zimmer-compact.pn.name: Signature, Joel Zimmer, compact, raster
assets/signatures/joel-zimmer-compact.pn.note: Transparent PNG of Joel Zimmer's compact signature, 1200px tall. Same rule: SVG unless the destination refuses it.

assets/videos/rtmc-city-gathering.mp4.name: Loop, Revival To My City
assets/videos/rtmc-city-gathering.mp4.capture: SLC Conference · Sanga, Mbarara, Uganda · 30 Jul 2026
assets/videos/rtmc-city-gathering.mp4.note: Muted looping hero for the CLEAN door. A city-wide gathering with hands raised, in daylight. Replaced an evening loop that measured roughly half the brightness and half the sharpness, which fought CLEAN's light register. Highlights were then pulled down: the sky as shot sat around the same luminance as the white page ground, so the band dissolved into it and the white above read as grey. The correction is exposure only, applied to the highlights, and recovers what the camera overexposed. Midtones, skin tones and colour are as captured. Do not restyle it further.

assets/logos/rtmc/rtmc-wordmark.svg.name: Revival To My City, primary lockup
assets/logos/rtmc/rtmc-wordmark.svg.note: The full mark with the endorsement line. Default wherever the name is introduced. Set in DM Sans at weight 900 and converted to outlines, so it is artwork rather than live text: it needs no font installed, never reflows, and recolours by changing one fill value. Never re-set it in another face, never stretch it, never rebuild the tick rule by hand.

gaps: The logo masters are a vector reconstruction, not an original drawing: the letterforms and the microphone are an autotrace, so curves are dense polygons. Invisible on screen and in normal print. Before any large-format use, a banner, a vehicle wrap, or a building sign, the mark should be redrawn as true curves and approved. Until then request large-format artwork rather than scaling these files up.
No published partnership or co-brand lockup. /assets states the rules for building one, and the first approved use is to be published there so nobody rebuilds it a second way.

A reversed signature for dark grounds. Every signature published here is Midnight ink and works only on Parchment or white. Nothing signed may appear on Midnight, Word Blue, or footage until a reversed master exists. Recolor the SVG fill rather than inverting the raster.

Location on every July 2026 caption is recorded as Sanga, Mbarara, Uganda from the capture folder and has not yet been confirmed against the official ministry record. Confirm it, then unbracket the older captions that still read [City].

The EVERY1 mark, commissioned from the family grammar (Brand Guide §11, v5.8): heavy DM Sans caps as outlines, hairline rule with a single Flame tick, endorsement line, and the 1 built to stand alone at avatar scale. Until approved, EVERY1 surfaces carry the parent wordmark beside BURN.

The School of the Local Church academic seal (Brand Guide §11, v5.8): a shield bearing the Lion of Judah, ringed with the School's name, single colour, with masters for print, blind emboss, and wax. Until approved, certificates close with the two signatures and the letterhead rule alone.

Per-door capture libraries (Brand Guide §11, v5.8). RTMC: night altar calls, the host city by day, the host church serving, the empty venue. EVERY1: one-to-one moments away from any stage, the handoff, vertical 9:16 first. SLC: the classroom, the materials, the credential moment. Today all three doors draw from one conference.
